nations.speaker: Chi Chi Valenti
nations.context: Chi Chi on her first big piece, 'Nations' in Details: the voguers at the Tunnel, and why she picked the House of Xtravaganza
nations.quote: And then, when I was writing, my very first big piece of writing was for Details. And I was writing about these tribes in the night that I called nations, that hung together like families, like style tribes. And so one of the four tribes that I picked was the House of Xtravaganza because they, of all the houses that were around me at the time, they really had the strongest family feel.

the-death-of-downtown.speaker: Michael Musto
the-death-of-downtown.context: James asks Musto about 'The Death of Downtown', the piece he wrote after Andy Warhol died in 1987
the-death-of-downtown.quote: Well, Warhol to me was the centerpiece of the scene. When you saw him in a room, you knew you were in the right place. Everyone craved his validation. I know I did... In any case, not only did Andy die, but the clubs were dying. The excitement was dying. People were moving on. Yuppies were taking over. The paying customers, the dreaded bridge-and-tunnel people, were taking over and the press was drying up.
